Links conductivity changes to coarse particle detachment via double layer compression and hydration force screening
parsed.objective_technical_problem: Preventing coarse particle detachment in flotation by maintaining sufficient electrostatic and van der Waals attachment forces amid varying ionic strength conditions

parsed.non_obvious_reason: The shift from monitoring bulk reagent efficacy to inferring surface-specific chemical potential gradients for targeted control is not a routine extension of threshold-based dosing logic.
